hero.title: Let's Connect
hero.description: Do you run a padel community, want to partner with Riviera Open, or become a sponsor? We connect players, organizers, and brands through a professional system with real-time national rankings and communities linked nationwide.

card.title: Grow your community with Riviera Open
card.description: Run retas, leagues, and tournaments without losing your identity. Every result feeds into the national ranking, and your players can follow their progress in real time.
card.benefit2: Full history for every player and event.
card.benefit3: Communities connected under their own identity.

banner.line1: The best communities don't just organize matches - they build competition.
banner.line2: Are you already playing in Riviera Open?
